text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, lansoprazole 30 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across the three Corvale sites ranges from 15 to 28 days on hand. Corvale East has 182 units (19 days), Corvale General has 255.96 units (27.8 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 35 units (15.3 days).

Why (FDA record): The product label lists A-S Medication Solutions (FEI 1450743) as the registered plant. FDA issued a Warning Letter to that plant on 2017-06-05. The most recent inspection of the plant was classified VAI and ended on 2026-08-12.

Our position: Supply is limited but not in shortage per FDA. The lowest site has 15.3 days on hand. We should secure additional stock from a supplier not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (not on FDA shortage list; plant Hetero Labs Limited Unit III last inspected VAI 2023-07-21). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Buyer to evaluate Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as backup sources (none on FDA shortage list; plant information not placed). Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Buyer to report procurement status and updated days-on-hand to P&T Committee at next meeting. Approval: P&T Committee Chair.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative proton pump inhibitors or changing formularies without clinical review by the treating clinicians and the committee.
